policy.name: Unprivileged Entra ID users with weak MFA
policy.description: Unprivileged users protected only by SMS, voice, or email-based MFA can still be bypassed by SIM-swap attacks and adversary-in-the-middle phishing. The risk is lower than for privileged accounts, but unprotected unprivileged accounts are routinely used as entry points for lateral movement and internal phishing.
frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK: TA0006, TA0001, TA0008, TA0004
Regulations: GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, CMMC
policy.manualRemediationProcess: Register a strong MFA method on the user (Microsoft Authenticator with number matching, FIDO2, or Windows Hello for Business). Update the Conditional Access policy that covers the user (directly or via group membership) to require an authentication strength that excludes SMS and voice.
